description: This file defines a generic implementation of a segmented (interval) tree data structure, including building, updating, and querying functions with support for lazy propagation. It appears to facilitate efficient range operations such as sum, min, or max, depending on the provided operations.

classes.name: SegmentedTree
classes.description: A generic, parameterized segment tree class supporting range updates and queries with lazy propagation.
